title: Doesn’t heat very well. It barely warms my bathroom
text: Doesn’t heat very well. It barely warms my bathroom. I like that it has a safety switch that turns off the heater if it tips over. However it does not heat well. I have a fairly small bathroom and it only takes the chill out. It would only be good for warming your feet under a desk.

product_metadata.title: Portable Space Heaters, 500-Watt Ceramic Small Space Heater, 3s Fast Heating Personal Mini Heater with Over-heat & Tip-over Protection
features: High Efficiency - Featuring efficient ceramic coils that heat up in seconds.
Portable Size - Compact small space heater design that is suitable for tables or desktops.
Multiple Protection - Overheating protection, automatic power off at high temperature. Flame-retardant material, prevent burning at high temperatures. Includes tip-over protection for extra safety.
Use with Ease - The space heater works without light, noise, flame and oxygen. You can enjoy a peaceful sleep. It is also good for baby room.
NOTE: When the heater is working, please place it on a flat plane to make sure the switch on the bottom with tip-over protection will work. The space heater come with 1 year warranty.
